review_scope: Independent static visual review only; no final approval, production/publication authorization or mechanical certification.
method: Each of five original marketing.webp files and all twenty original desktop/mobile closed/open PNGs was inspected individually using vision; no boards substituted. Mozambique desktop-open additionally inspected as a crop. All five per-ID source_readme.md files read.

verdict_meaning.pass: No blocking visual discrepancy identified beyond disclosed stylization/promotional finish limitations; not final approval.
verdict_meaning.needs-decision: Visible aesthetic concern requires a human/art-direction decision; not an asserted runtime or geometry failure.

shared_limitations: Runtime checks are reported as passed by delegation/source context; not rerun or independently certified in this visual-only task.
Static front three-quarter views cannot establish continuous motion, rear/occluded attachments, collision clearance, manufacturing validity or physical-phone performance.
Hidden lid ornaments/hinges and disengaged open latch alone are not defects.
Promotional lighting, material polish and detail density are not treated as exact runtime geometry requirements.

reviews.hardware: Brass corner caps, long front clasp, separate round fitting, side ring and stone feet remain recognizable versus marketing. Rear hinge sections are visible open. Green closed seam is conspicuous but consistent with the design, not demonstrated misclosure.
reviews.terrain: Cedar retains visible trunk, tiered airy foliage and mossed rocky mound. Runtime foliage is more stippled/planar and moss less plush than the promotional illustration; this agrees with the bounded v2 source limitations.
reviews.texture: Runtime wood is brighter orange and more repetitive than the richer promotional grain; brass and stone are simplified. These are finish/rendering differences, not demonstrated geometry defects.
reviews.mobile_open: Closed mobile preserves tree/mound and hardware silhouettes, but fine needles/moss and small fittings lose definition. Desktop/mobile open show hollow wood interior, raised lid and released clasp, fully framed. Exterior tree faces away and is occluded; not evidence it disappeared.
limitations: No botanical or photoreal equivalence to marketing.
Moss/foliage detail cannot be resolved fully at default mobile size.

reviews.hardware: Front clasp, separate round fitting, side ring, corner caps and gray stone feet are present. Rear hinge sections are visible open; no obvious detached hardware. Broad dark closed seam is documented, not proof of broken closure.
reviews.terrain: No landscape terrain expected: cream/carmine raised panel and three cabochons are the motif. All three domes are visible closed, including mobile; panel can read as a rigid insert.
reviews.texture: Marketing has paler wood, peach glossy domes and softer satin metal. Runtime is warmer with opaque honey-yellow domes, repetitive grain and poorly resolved linen weave. Promotional finish differences do not establish missing geometry.
reviews.mobile_open: Entire model and controls fit both mobile poses. Closed mobile retains three ornaments and border; open views show plain wood cavity and lid underside. Exterior linen/amber faces away as documented, so its absence from the open front view is not a theme failure.
limitations: Cannot establish realistic amber translucency or woven fibers from these views.
Open view does not inspect exterior ornament attachments behind the lid.

reviews.hardware: Brass clasp, round front fitting, side ring, corner caps and stone feet read consistently; rear hinges are visible open. No unequivocal hardware separation or clipping.
reviews.terrain: Pale angular limestone pinnacles with sheltered green patches and vertically fluted body match marketing motif. Peaks form a stylized fairly regular field rather than a dense natural tsingy labyrinth; green patches are subtle on mobile.
reviews.texture: Marketing has softer stone veining and more polished lighting. Runtime shows repetitive flutes/streaking and conspicuous wavy interior/lid-underside texture. The latter is explicitly disclosed in source context: aesthetic procedural finish, not demonstrated UV corruption or mesh damage.
reviews.mobile_open: Closed mobile retains peak silhouette but fine rock/green detail is limited. Open desktop/mobile expose dark hollow liner, pale wavy underside and brass attachments; exterior peaks face away. Both poses fit without obvious cropping.
limitations: Cannot visually count or validate all individual peaks/patches from these views.
Interior wave pattern is conspicuous and non-naturalistic, but a disclosed finish limitation.

reviews.hardware: Family long brass clasp, round front fitting, side ring, corner caps and basalt-like feet are present. Rear fittings visible open; no evident detached pieces. Dark closed seam is intentional per source context, not a proven alignment defect.
reviews.terrain: Shallow rolling pastel mineral ribbons retain the marketing composition and warm earth body. Relief is deliberately smooth/graphic; several ribbons blend or occlude at mobile scale.
reviews.texture: Marketing is softly lit salmon/peach with smoother finish. Runtime is copper/terracotta with broad procedural wavy tonal bands on body and interior. This is promotional finish/material variation rather than missing terrain geometry.
reviews.mobile_open: Model and raised latch remain fully within mobile and desktop frames. Open views expose warm hollow cavity and lid underside, not the exterior multicolor ribbons; lack of seven visible colors in the open view is expected.
limitations: All seven ribbons cannot be confidently counted visually at default mobile size; source verification is contextual, not re-executed here.
Earth walls read as smooth clay rather than granular geological terrain.

reviews.hardware: Brass front clasp, circular fitting, side ring, corner guards and pale feet match the reference family. Rear hardware is visible open but fine connection details are ambiguous; no proven detachment. Recessed teal seam and released latch are not failures.
reviews.terrain: Closed views show three stylized cream raised sandbanks on turquoise water, matching marketing silhouette/palette. Mounds read as simple peaks; opaque mapped water is not physical fluid. Open front view naturally conceals the exterior relief.
reviews.texture: Fine repetitive ivory body ripples read somewhat wood-like. Desktop-open turquoise lid inner face shows an otherwise sinuous dark channel interrupted by abrupt straight-edged/wedge-like transitions near its ends; confirmed in an additional crop of the original. This is a visible mapping/finish continuity concern, not proof of broken mesh or missing terrain.
reviews.mobile_open: Closed mobile keeps ivory/turquoise motif readable, though small hardware is simplified. Open mobile is fully framed with visible pale cavity and turquoise inner lid; the channel is mostly flat-looking and the abrupt transitions are less assessable at this size.
limitations: Static image cannot distinguish UV placement, shading or geometry as the cause of channel discontinuities.
No requirement for photoreal water or coastal geography is inferred.
reviews.decision: Owner/art-direction decision requested on whether abrupt channel terminations on the visible lid underside are acceptable intentional mapping or merit a later texture refinement. No geometry repair is prescribed and no art was changed.
